note: Machine-readable map of CRA Annex I requirements to automated checks, offensive test procedures, and pass/fail evidence. automated_check is null when the requirement cannot be verified from a firmware image alone (manual procedure only).

requirements.title: No known exploitable vulnerabilities at ship time

attacker_test.procedure: Generate an SBOM of the shipped image (syft) and cross-check every component against OSV.
attacker_test.evidence: Component name+version with matching CVE/advisory IDs.
attacker_test.pass: No component resolves to a known vulnerability.
attacker_test.fail: At least one shipped component has a known vulnerability.

attacker_test.procedure: Parse every ELF in the rootfs for NX, PIE, stack canary, and RELRO.
attacker_test.pass: Executables ship with NX, PIE, canary, and RELRO enabled.
attacker_test.fail: Executables ship without standard exploit mitigations.

requirements.title: Confidentiality: no plaintext secrets on the image

attacker_test.procedure: Scan the rootfs for private keys, hardcoded credentials, and known secret formats.
attacker_test.evidence: File path + matched secret type (PEM private key, API token, password entry).
attacker_test.pass: No embedded private keys or hardcoded credentials.
attacker_test.fail: Private key or hardcoded credential present in the image.

requirements.title: Secure by default: no empty or default password accounts

attacker_test.procedure: Inspect /etc/passwd and /etc/shadow for empty password hashes or known default hashes.
attacker_test.evidence: Account name with empty/weak password field.
attacker_test.pass: No login account ships with an empty or default password.
attacker_test.fail: An account ships with an empty or default password.

requirements.title: Minimize attack surface: no insecure network services enabled by default

attacker_test.procedure: Detect telnet/ftp/rsh daemons and their default-enabled autostart entries.
attacker_test.evidence: Service binary + init/autostart reference enabling it.
attacker_test.pass: No cleartext remote-admin service enabled by default.
attacker_test.fail: telnetd/ftpd/rshd or equivalent enabled by default.

requirements.title: Secure update mechanism: signed firmware updates

attacker_test.procedure: Flash an unsigned and a downgraded firmware image and observe whether the device accepts it.
attacker_test.evidence: Device boot log accepting an unsigned/downgraded image.
attacker_test.pass: Device rejects unsigned or downgraded images.
attacker_test.fail: Device accepts an unsigned or downgraded image.

attacker_test.procedure: Confirm a machine-readable SBOM (CycloneDX or SPDX) is provided and covers top-level components.
attacker_test.evidence: Presence and format of the SBOM artifact.
attacker_test.pass: Machine-readable SBOM present covering shipped components.

attacker_test.procedure: Check for a published security contact (security.txt / CVD policy).
attacker_test.evidence: Reachable security contact or its absence.
attacker_test.pass: A reporting contact and CVD policy are published.
